#### Throughput {#sec-ppc-524}

[**Summary of Throughput**]{#sec-ppc-524-summary}

The throughput is summarized in the following table (this was part of the original data collection, not the result of analysis).

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
throughput <- tibble(
  machine = factor(rep(1:3, each = 3)),
  day = factor(rep(1:3, 3)),
  throughput = c(576, 604, 583, 657, 604, 586, 510, 546, 571)
)

throughput |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = day, values_from = throughput, names_prefix = "Day ")
```

This table shows that machine 3 had significantly lower throughput.

[**Graphical Representation of Throughput**]{#sec-ppc-524-graph}

We can show the throughput graphically.

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| label: fig-ppc-524-throughput
#| fig-cap: "Throughput by machine, with range bars connecting the minimum and maximum of each machine's three daily counts"
throughput_range <- throughput |>
  summarise(ymin = min(throughput), ymax = max(throughput), .by = machine)

ggplot(throughput, aes(machine, throughput)) +
  geom_segment(
    data = throughput_range,
    aes(x = machine, xend = machine, y = ymin, yend = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(throughput$throughput), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "Machine", y = "Throughput") +
  theme_light()
```

The graph clearly shows the lower throughput for machine 3.

[**Analysis of Variance for Throughput**]{#sec-ppc-524-anova}

We can confirm the statistical significance of the lower throughput of machine 3 by running an analysis of variance.

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
fit_throughput <- aov(throughput ~ machine, data = throughput)
summary(fit_throughput)
```

[**Interpretation of ANOVA Output**]{#sec-ppc-524-anova-interpretation}

We summarize the level means for machine in the following table.

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
throughput_summary <- summary(fit_throughput)[[1]]
rmse_tp <- sqrt(throughput_summary["Residuals", "Mean Sq"])
resid_dof_tp <- throughput_summary["Residuals", "Df"]
Tvalue_tp <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, df = resid_dof_tp)

throughput |>
  summarise(n = n(), Mean = mean(throughput), .by = machine) |>
  mutate(
    `Standard Error` = rmse_tp / sqrt(n),
    `Lower 95% CI` = round(Mean - Tvalue_tp * `Standard Error`, 2),
    `Upper 95% CI` = round(Mean + Tvalue_tp * `Standard Error`, 2),
    Mean = round(Mean, 2),
    `Standard Error` = round(`Standard Error`, 2)
  ) |>
  rename(Level = machine, Number = n)
```
